name: f1-four-verdicts
alt: One sealed archive of three files, checked four ways. Intact archive: verified, exit 0. One byte changed: failed, exit 2. Required artifact missing: not-established, exit 3. Below, over time: the same archive is read by the verifier, then by the verifier with its lens glass swapped. Both print verified, exit 0, and both receipts are kept in one binder.
